original_test_intent: Set an approved subset of threshold fields for one verified sensor over OOB, prove exact readback and bounded monitoring behavior, then restore the complete captured threshold baseline.
original_method: Retain Sensor/Event raw 0x04/0x26, but require the complete IPMI v2.0 Table 35-8 payload: sensor number, set-select mask, and all six threshold byte positions in LNC, LC, LNR, UNC, UC and UNR order.
manual_activity: The monitoring owner approves the dedicated target, exact sensor, set-select bits and six-byte payload, expected event effect, maintenance window, abort conditions and byte-for-byte restoration.
required_inputs: Verified BMC, channel, sensor number and SDR identity
All six ordered threshold bytes, including unchanged baseline positions
SDR units, scaling, valid ordering and reserved-value rules
Bounded event stimulus and expected assertion/deassertion result
Exact restore payload and independent recovery owner
safety_requirements: Preserve SEL, BMC and OS logs
Never execute the source's empty 0x26 request
Set only supported allowlisted threshold bits
Populate all six payload positions from approved values or captured baseline
Do not change hysteresis or event-enable masks
One approved write followed by readback
Abort on event storm, monitoring loss or concurrent overwrite
Restore and verify the complete baseline
agent_execution_scope: Verify target, sensor-to-SDR mapping and threshold support
Capture raw 0x04/0x27 baseline and event/log state
Validate the proposed set-select mask and ordered six-byte payload
Present the exact byte diff for owner confirmation
Issue one raw 0x04/0x26 request with the approved complete payload
Read back with raw 0x04/0x27 and observe the bounded event oracle
Restore the captured baseline and reverify
Archive preserved evidence and no-collateral-change results
engineer_actions: Approve the sensor, mask, values, stimulus and maintenance window
Own independent recovery if readback or restoration fails

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: DeepSeek correctly refuses the incomplete source command; a package can execute the standard write only after target-specific threshold semantics and owner approval are supplied.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: After approval, issue one secret-safe raw 0x04 0x26 <sensor> <set-select> <LNC> <LC> <LNR> <UNC> <UC> <UNR> request as defined by IPMI v2.0 Table 35-8, using captured baseline bytes in every unselected position; verify with raw 0x04 0x27 <sensor> and restore the baseline.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The source's in-band/OOB 0x04/0x26 family and 10/5 timing remain recorded; absent request bytes are defects, not values to infer.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a field-aware transaction that validates the writable mask, ordering, engineering-unit conversion and cross-threshold invariants before one write, then requires exact readback, bounded event evidence and full restore.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Replaces unsafe empty requests and success-only acceptance with a complete reversible threshold lifecycle while leaving the Master unchanged.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A read-only 0x27 check cannot satisfy the required functional write, and this case does not cover hysteresis or event-enable configuration.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Incorrect threshold order, scaling or mask bits can suppress legitimate alarms or create an event storm; firmware may clamp or overwrite values.

project_override_considerations: A vendor API is equivalent only if it identifies the same sensor and individual threshold fields, exposes raw/effective readback, preserves unselected values and supports exact restore; opaque profile changes are not equivalent.
expected_evidence: Owner approval and dedicated target/firmware/channel/sensor/SDR identity
Readable/writable masks, baseline and exact proposed byte diff
0x04/0x27 raw readback plus decoded engineering values
Bounded event/monitoring trace and preserved SEL/BMC/OS logs

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The title and both source commands consistently target Set Sensor Threshold. The missing payload, success-only criterion and evidence-clearing boilerplate are severe completeness and safety defects, but no source statements prescribe incompatible outcomes; the Review adds a conditional complete transaction without rewriting the Master.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The standard function and payload schema are identifiable. Target sensor capability, approved values, event oracle and restore data are Project execution-readiness inputs; the run must become BLOCKED if any remains unverifiable at execution time.

review_improvement: Prevents an empty or partially populated threshold write, enforces the Table 35-8 field order and mask semantics, and makes readback, monitoring effect and exact recovery mandatory.
independent_technical_reasoning: Set Sensor Threshold carries six ordered threshold positions even when only selected mask bits are changed. Omitting or guessing the sensor, set-select mask, any byte position, scaling or cross-threshold ordering can silently alter alarm behavior. A completion code therefore proves only transport acceptance; meaningful coverage requires an approved field-level diff, 0x27 readback, bounded event behavior and full baseline restoration.
